name: Body Scan Meditation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down (or sit comfortably)
instructions: Lie down in a comfortable position with your arms relaxed at your sides, and close your eyes.
Take several deep breaths, consciously relaxing your body with each exhale.
Begin at the top of your head, slowly bringing attention down through your face, jaw, and neck, noticing and softening any tension.
Continue down through your shoulders, arms, hands, chest, and back, spending extra time on any areas holding stress.
Move through your belly, hips, thighs, knees, calves, and feet, pausing to breathe into each area before moving on.
Once you reach your toes, take a moment to sense your entire body resting, breathing as one connected whole.
Gently wiggle your fingers and toes, take a deep breath, and slowly open your eyes.
